title: Two-dimensional seepage analysis using a polygonal cell-based smoothed finite element method
summary: This study develops a polygonal cell-based smoothed finite element method (CSFEM) for two-dimensional seepage analyses in porous media, covering steady-state, transient, and free-surface problems. Wachspress interpolation on convex polygonal elements is combined with cell-based gradient smoothing, so that element matrices are assembled using boundary integrals only, avoiding in-element derivatives and improving robustness on distorted and locally refined meshes.
